in_sanskrit.name: लहर
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The continuous flow of a river or an ocean, or the continuous flow of emotions. It can also refer to a flood or a deluge.

in_hindi.name: लहर
in_hindi.long_meaning: To flow, to move continuously, to excite, to attract.

in_tamil.name: லகர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: All waves, or the continuous flow of anything.

in_telugu.name: లహోద్దీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: One who flows continuously, or a continuous flow.

in_marathi.name: Lahar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lahar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'lahara', meaning 'to flow' or 'wave'. In Hindu mythology, Lahar is a name of Lord Vishnu, representing the continuous flow of life. It is also the name of the goddess of fertility and motherhood.
